messages:
michael_support: FYI inbound escalation 60s - Novum Health trial can't exchange tokens. Multiple 401s during onboarding flow. They're blocked and mention renewal conversation in ~3 weeks. Escalating to CS.

infra-bot: Ticket created #46210 (P1) - https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/46210 - product=redwood-api severity=P1

tara_csm: Thanks Michael. I can take point. Can someone confirm ownership of the fix and a short timeline? @juan_engineer?

juan_engineer: jumping in. Logs show intermittent 401 at /oauth/token. Suspect client secret mismatch or IdP rate limiting. I can add a permissive test rule in staging to verify token flow quickly; won't push prod without AM confirmation.

ryan_am: I just pinged the customer. Security will only surface prod client id during a recorded enablement session. I'll book a 30-45m call for today. Note: if this drags >48h renewal risk becomes elevated.

michael_support: Draft comms below - please tweak. If approved I'll send and attach calendar.

michael_support: ```Proposed comms:
- T+0: acknowledge & own issue (CS)
- T+1h: enablement call (CS + AM + Eng) to swap/confirm prod client id
- T+2h: eng verifies token exchange in staging
- T+4h: conditional prod deploy with customer-led secret rotation
- T+24h: follow-up & capture onboarding success metrics
Contingency: escalate to CSM director if unresolved at T+6h; consider temporary credit if commercial impact severe.```

tara_csm: I can run 14:30 PT call. I'll ask for screen share of IdP and record steps. Sending invite now.

juan_engineer: Staging test rule applied. Token exchange returns 200 for test client id. Waiting on AM to confirm prod id before prod push. Logs attached to ticket.

ryan_am: Customer accepted 14:30. Confirmed they'll share prod client id on call. Added renewal note for director (low->monitoring).

infra-bot: Ticket #46210 updated: status=investigating assignees=[tara_csm, juan_engineer] priority=P1

tara_csm: Post-call: confirmed client id mismatch, rotated secret with customer, eng deployed fix to prod, smoke tests green. Onboarding resumed. I've updated ticket and CS board with steps and recommended playbook change to ask for prod client id earlier in onboarding checklist.

michael_support: Great work. Please add a one-line sentiment and time-to-fix to renewal sheet so retention can follow up. Closing handoff after that.

tara_csm: Added summary to renewal sheet; closing thread.
